meta.title: A live RFQ: "Withdrawing Order...": "Cancel" closes it and changes nothing
gaps: Directly prove that all vendor assignments are unchanged before and after cancellation.
Directly compare all event start and end times before and after cancellation.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly prove that all vendor assignments are unchanged before and after cancellation.; Directly compare all event start and end times before and after cancellation.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's event summary, as required for this fixed state.
Navigate to the RFQ stage named in the case.
Open the Responses tab where the case begins the withdrawal flow.
Open the RFQ withdrawal window without confirming the withdrawal.
Verify that the withdrawal window opened.
Verify that cancelling closes the withdrawal window.
Verify that the event still shows its live status after cancellation.
Verify that no bid response was introduced or removed by cancelling.
Confirm the Responses screen has no rendering or server errors after cancellation.
